jobs.name: work-sparql
rules:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
CONSTRUCT { ?person ex:worksInCountry ?country } WHERE { ?person ex:worksFor ?company . ?company ex:locatedIn ?country }

PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
CONSTRUCT { ?person ex:worksOnContinent ?continent } WHERE { ?person ex:worksInCountry ?country . ?country ex:onContinent ?continent }

tests.name: derives the country a person works in
tests.given: ex:alice ex:worksFor ex:acme . ex:acme ex:locatedIn ex:france . ex:france ex:onContinent ex:europe .

tests.name: rules read the original data only, so the continent is not derived in one pass
tests.given: ex:alice ex:worksFor ex:acme . ex:acme ex:locatedIn ex:france . ex:france ex:onContinent ex:europe .

jobs.name: totals
rules:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
CONSTRUCT { ?line ex:total ?total } WHERE { ?line ex:unitPrice ?price ; ex:quantity ?quantity . BIND(?price * ?quantity AS ?total) FILTER(?total > 10) }

tests.name: totals above 10 only
tests.given: ex:l1 ex:unitPrice 5 ; ex:quantity 3 . ex:l2 ex:unitPrice 2 ; ex:quantity 3 .

tests.name: chains both rules: country, then continent
tests.given: ex:alice ex:worksFor ex:acme . ex:acme ex:locatedIn ex:france . ex:france ex:onContinent ex:europe .
tests.expect: ex:alice ex:worksInCountry ex:france . ex:alice ex:worksOnContinent ex:europe .

tests.name: a subclass instance is also an instance of the superclass
tests.given: ex:Car rdfs:subClassOf ex:Vehicle . ex:car1 a ex:Car .

tests.name: the range of hasLossReserve types the amount
tests.prefixes: @prefix ins: <http://data.world/schema/insurance/> . @prefix rsk: <https://risk.example.org/vocab#> . @prefix ex: <https://claims.example.org/vocab#> . @prefix fin: <https://finance.example.org/vocab#> . @prefix d: <urn:test:> . @prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
tests.given: ins:hasLossReserve rdfs:range ins:LossReserve . d:claim ins:hasLossReserve d:amount .

jobs.name: portfolio-risk

inputs.name: portfolio

rules:
PREFIX ins: <http://data.world/schema/insurance/>
PREFIX ex: <https://claims.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX fin: <https://finance.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX rsk: <https://risk.example.org/vocab#>
CONSTRUCT { ?policy rsk:atRisk true } WHERE { ?claim ex:onPolicy ?policy ; ex:severity "high" }

PREFIX ins: <http://data.world/schema/insurance/>
PREFIX ex: <https://claims.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX fin: <https://finance.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX rsk: <https://risk.example.org/vocab#>
CONSTRUCT { ?policy rsk:highSeverityClaims ?count } WHERE { SELECT ?policy (COUNT(?claim) AS ?count) WHERE { ?claim ex:onPolicy ?policy ; ex:severity "high" } GROUP BY ?policy }

PREFIX ins: <http://data.world/schema/insurance/>
PREFIX ex: <https://claims.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX fin: <https://finance.example.org/vocab#>
PREFIX rsk: <https://risk.example.org/vocab#>
CONSTRUCT { ?policy rsk:riskNote ?note } WHERE { ?claim ex:onPolicy ?policy ; ex:severity "high" ; ex:narrative ?text . ?policy ins:policyNumber ?n ; fin:costCentre ?cc ; fin:budgetOwner ?owner . BIND(CONCAT("Policy ", ?n, " owned by ", ?owner, " (", ?cc, ") has a high-severity claim: ", ?text) AS ?note) }

tests.name: a high-severity claim puts its policy at risk, with a count and a note
tests.given: d:c1 ex:onPolicy d:p1 ; ex:severity "high" ; ex:narrative "Pipe burst" . d:c2 ex:onPolicy d:p2 ; ex:severity "low" ; ex:narrative "Scratch" . d:p1 ins:policyNumber "111" ; fin:costCentre "CC-1" ; fin:budgetOwner "Dana" . d:p2 ins:policyNumber "222" ; fin:costCentre "CC-2" ; fin:budgetOwner "Lee" .
tests.expect: d:p1 rsk:atRisk true ; rsk:highSeverityClaims 1 ; rsk:riskNote "Policy 111 owned by Dana (CC-1) has a high-severity claim: Pipe burst" .

jobs.name: reserved-claims
rules:
PREFIX ins: <http://data.world/schema/insurance/>
PREFIX rsk: <https://risk.example.org/vocab#>
# Needs stage 1: the LossReserve type is a deduction of the OWL-RL job `acme`, not stored data.
CONSTRUCT { ?claim rsk:hasReserve ?amount } WHERE { ?claim ins:hasLossReserve ?amount . ?amount a ins:LossReserve }

tests.name: only claims whose reserve was typed upstream are flagged
tests.given: d:c1 ins:hasLossReserve d:a1 . d:a1 a ins:LossReserve . d:c2 ins:hasLossReserve d:a2 .

jobs.name: reserve-summary
rules:
PREFIX ins: <http://data.world/schema/insurance/>
PREFIX rsk: <https://risk.example.org/vocab#>
# Needs stage 2: rsk:hasReserve exists only in the output of `reserved-claims`.
CONSTRUCT { ?policy rsk:reservedClaims ?count } WHERE { SELECT ?policy (COUNT(DISTINCT ?claim) AS ?count) WHERE { ?claim rsk:hasReserve ?amount ; ins:against ?detail . ?detail ins:hasPolicy ?policy } GROUP BY ?policy }

tests.name: counts reserved claims per policy
tests.given: d:c1 rsk:hasReserve d:a1 ; ins:against d:x1 . d:c2 rsk:hasReserve d:a2 ; ins:against d:x2 . d:c3 rsk:hasReserve d:a3 ; ins:against d:x3 . d:x1 ins:hasPolicy d:p1 . d:x2 ins:hasPolicy d:p1 . d:x3 ins:hasPolicy d:p2 .

tests.name: a claim cannot be both open and closed
